And that is precisely the issue which has been preoccupying us for the past couple of years.
Why This Conference, Why Now

We’ve been to many a meeting where AI was discussed theoretically – lofty concepts, grandiose predictions, loads of slidewares. Ai4 has made a name for itself based on quite a different impulse. The agenda is heavily tilted towards practical, industry-focused discussions: there is a track for financial services, another for healthcare, yet another one for manufacturing, retail, cybersecurity, insurance, energy, national security, and media. There are also tracks focused on agentic AI, generative AI, and where AI truly has an impact, versus where it does not amount to much yet. The sessions span the full spectrum from beginner tracks called “New to AI” up to very technical sessions with enterprise success stories that give you the nitty-gritty details of what went wrong, what went right, and what it cost.
This mix of professionals, rather than keynote speakers only, is exactly the kind of audience we need to reach out to. Because that is whom we create for every day.
Who Else Will Be in the Room
As mentioned above, one of the main reasons that make this event so worthwhile to devote your precious time to is the sheer star power of the speaker lineup.

AI4 2026, already has confirmed speakers for the keynote track, including Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng – three speakers whose contribution has defined a lot of modern AI research. Besides them, Dmitri Dolgov and Sebastian Thrun from Waymo will be telling about future plans for autonomous systems, while the overall line-up also features cutting-edge researchers like Timothée Lacroix, Tom Gruber, and Ben Goertzel.

The list does not stop there; it includes not only research but also business applications: expect executives and practitioners from such companies as Cisco, PayPal, Priceline, AstraZeneca, Mayo Clinic, Ford, Caterpillar, NBCUniversal, U.S. Bank, and even U.S. Air Force, who will be sharing their experience in implementing AI solutions. It is the kind of speaker lineup that shows the event is not just about AI as an abstract concept but a conference dedicated to the implementation of real-life solutions, which work well in industrial-scale environments where there is no place for errors.

Pre-conference day on August 3 adds another layer worth planning around, with dedicated Technical and Business Summits, hands-on training built with General Assembly, and an Applied AI Research Conference presented alongside CSU — useful if you want to get technical before the main event’s networking energy takes over.
Where Q2M Solutions Fits into This Picture

For those who haven’t crossed paths with us yet: Q2M Solutions is an enterprise AI development company in India, delivering 150+ projects for enterprise clients from Azure data platforms and Microsoft Copilot to computer vision and process automation.

We’re a designated Microsoft Solution Partner for both Data & AI and Digital & App Innovation, hold Azure Expert certified competency, and have been recognised by Clutch as a Top AI Developer in the APAC region — all backed by ISO 27001 information security certification. Along the way we’ve learned a fairly unglamorous but important lesson: the hard part of AI was never the model. It’s getting a model to survive contact with your actual data, your actual infrastructure, and your actual users.

This is the perspective through which we approach our AI development services, including but not limited to developing agentic AI systems that can independently plan and execute complex workflows, deploying generative AI and Copilot powered by genuine RAG pipelines working in context of a client’s documents instead of confidently hallucinating, computer vision models performing quality checks at a factory floor, or legacy modernisation efforts that transform legacy applications to be cloud-native and API-first without any disruption to the business.

Our work goes well past pilot projects – our services are outcome-driven, with scope, milestones, and ROI determined even before a single line of code is written, and the performance measured by improvements such as increased speed of processing documents, decreased manual effort, and fast time-to-first value.

We operate in the finance, logistics & supply chain, healthcare, manufacturing, government, and SaaS spaces, with the relevant industry knowledge infused into our projects rather than a template approach. It’s very much what Ai4 was made for, so there should be quite a bit of common ground between us and those on the expo floor.
What to Expect from Us at Ai4 2026

We’re not going to Las Vegas to hand out pens and stress balls. Our team will be there to have real conversations — about where an AI initiative stalled, what a RAG pipeline actually costs to run reliably at scale, how to keep data inside your own Azure tenant while still moving fast, or what it takes to get an AI agent from a promising demo to something your compliance and governance teams will actually sign off on. If you’re wrestling with any of that, we’d genuinely like to compare notes.

We’d rather set up time in advance than rely on a chance hallway run-in. If you want to skip the expo-floor small talk and get straight to a working conversation, reach out ahead of time so neither of us is squinting at a booth number trying to find each other in a crowd of 12,000 people.
Let’s Grab Time in Vegas

Ai4 2026 runs August 4–6 at The Venetian, with pre-conference sessions kicking off August 3. If you’ll be there — as an attendee, a fellow exhibitor, or just someone quietly trying to figure out whether agentic AI is worth the hype for your business — we’d love to meet.

If you haven’t registered yet, passes are available directly through ai4.io/register — the Standard Pass gets you into keynotes, all track sessions, the exhibit hall, the networking app, and daily meals, while the enhanced pass adds a more premium networking experience on top. Rates step up the closer you get to August, so it’s worth locking in sooner rather than later if you’re planning to come.
Want to book time with our team while we’re there? Get in touch and we’ll set something up. Either way, we’re looking forward to Vegas, and to the conversations that come out of it.
See you at The Venetian.

blocks.text: SharePoint Framework v1.22.1: A Stability Update Developers Shouldn’t Skip

The release of the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) v1.22 is now available, and it’s a huge one. This release doesn’t include any new features or fixes, in contrast to earlier releases that did. Rather, three significant modifications to the “behind the scenes” component of SPFx projects are included in this release:
Finally, clean npm audit reports
Upgrade to TypeScript v5.8
A new build toolchain based on Heft
Let’s examine the latest developments and their implications for your development process.
What’s New?
Clean npm audits

If you have worked as an SPFx developer for any amount of time, you are probably aware of the several npm package vulnerabilities that have been reported. Many of these vulnerabilities are classified as high or critical, and they are all connected to dependencies that are located deep within the Microsoft toolchain packages.
Microsoft spent a lot of time updating dependencies for SPFx v1.22 in an effort to remove the need to run npm audits on your project after installing dependencies.

This is significant because, even in cases where the susceptible packages only run during development and never reach production, security teams at corporate firms frequently identify these vulnerabilities during code reviews. You may now present a flawless audit report with assurance.
TypeScript v5.8 by default

TypeScript v5.8 is used by default in new projects scaffolded with SPFx v1.22. This is a big improvement over earlier iterations and includes all the contemporary TypeScript features you’ve been lacking.
Significant toolchain redesign: switching from Gulp to Heft

Even while it might not seem like much, this release will have the greatest impact. Project development has undergone a dramatic change with the release of SPFx v1.22. A Heft-based toolchain will take the place of the outdated gulp-based toolchain that SPFx has used since version 1.0 in 2017.
The main topic of this blog is to highlight the new features of SPFx v1.22 version.
What’s your take on these changes? Are you planning to move to the new toolchain now, or will you wait? Share your migration approach in the comments and join the conversation.

blocks.text: Building a Single Pane of Glass for a 1,500-Truck Fleet
A RAG-powered, computer-vision fleet intelligence platform that cut cost leakage by 15% — built on AWS with Snap Spectacles smart glasses for hands-free inspection.
Book a Discovery Call
Executive Summary

A Denver-based logistics operator running a fleet of 1,500 heavy-duty trucks was losing an estimated 15% of its operating budget to preventable “cost leakage” – undetected mechanical faults, missed maintenance windows, misfiled compliance documents, and insurance claims that could not be substantiated with evidence.

The root problem was fragmentation. Fault detection, document management, scheduling, and Engine Control Module (ECM) telematics each lived in a separate, disconnected tool. No single channel gave dispatchers, mechanics, and compliance staff a shared view of a truck’s real condition and history.

We designed and delivered a single fleet-intelligence platform on AWS that unifies all four functions. It pairs a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge assistant with computer-vision fault detection, a hands-free Snap Spectacles smart-glasses inspection workflow, an intelligent maintenance scheduler, and continuous ECM data ingestion. The same evidence pipeline also powers insurance fraud detection, giving the operator time-stamped, tamper-evident proof for every claim.
Within [X] months of rollout, the platform reduced measurable cost leakage by approximately 15% across the fleet.
The Client Challenge

The operator managed a large, aging, high-utilisation fleet. Interviews with dispatch, maintenance, and compliance teams surfaced a consistent theme: there was no single channel connecting the data they each depended on. Separately, the operator was losing disputes on insurance claims because it could not produce credible, time-stamped evidence of a vehicle’s condition before and after an incident. Fraudulent and inflated claims went unchallenged.
Fault detection was reactive
Mechanical issues were typically caught only after a breakdown or a roadside inspection failure, driving up towing, downtime, and emergency-repair costs.
Document management was manual
Registrations, inspection reports, driver logs, and maintenance records were scattered across email, shared drives, and paper. Retrieving the right document during an audit could take hours.
Scheduling was guesswork
Preventive maintenance and driver assignments were planned on spreadsheets, with no link to a truck’s actual mechanical condition or ECM telemetry.
ECM data was siloed
Rich engine telemetry — fault codes, fuel burn, idle time, engine load — was locked inside the trucks and rarely correlated with maintenance or cost decisions.
One Platform, Four Capabilities
We built a unified fleet-intelligence platform - a genuine single pane of glass - that ingests every relevant data source and exposes it through one web console and one mobile/wearable workflow.

Computer-vision fault detection Mechanics and drivers capture vehicle imagery during walkarounds. A custom-trained YOLOv8 object-detection model, complemented by Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels, identifies visible faults — tire wear and damage, brake and rotor issues, fluid leaks, corrosion, and lamp/reflector defects — and grades severity automatically. Detected issues are logged against the specific vehicle and pushed straight into the scheduler.

Hands-free inspection with Snap Spectacles Inspections run through Snap Spectacles smart glasses using a custom Lens built with Snap’s Camera Kit / Lens Studio SDK. Technicians keep both hands on the vehicle while the glasses stream first-person imagery to the vision pipeline and surface AR prompts and checklists in their field of view. Every capture is time-stamped and geotagged, creating a defensible inspection record without a single form being filled in by hand.

RAG knowledge assistant for documents & ECM At the core is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation assistant that lets any authorised user ask natural-language questions — “When is truck 412 due for service?”, “Show the last three inspection reports for this VIN”, “Which trucks have an open DEF-system fault code?” The assistant is grounded in the client’s own documents and live ECM data, so answers are specific, cited, and auditable rather than generic.

Condition-aware scheduler An intelligent scheduler fuses vision findings, ECM fault codes, mileage, and compliance deadlines to generate predictive maintenance and driver-assignment plans. Instead of fixed-interval servicing, trucks are serviced when the data says they need it — cutting both premature maintenance spend and breakdown risk.

ECM data pipeline Engine Control Module data streams continuously from the fleet into the platform, where it is normalised, correlated with each vehicle’s record, and made queryable by both the scheduler and the RAG assistant — finally connecting engine reality to business decisions.
Technical Architecture
The platform is a cloud-native, event-driven system built entirely on AWS, combining managed AI services with custom-trained models. The named models and services are summarised below.
AI & machine-learning models

Layer Technology / Model RAG generation (LLM) Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, served via Amazon Bedrock Text embeddings Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 (for semantic retrieval) Knowledge orchestration Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases Vector store Amazon OpenSearch Serverless (vector engine) Visual fault detection Custom-trained YOLOv8 + Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels Document / OCR extraction Amazon Textract Fraud & anomaly detection Amazon Fraud Detector + custom XGBoost model on Amazon SageMaker
Platform & data services

Layer Technology / Model Smart-glasses capture) Snap Spectacles + Snap Camera Kit / Lens Studio SDK Telemetry ingestion AWS IoT Core → Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (ECM data) Scheduling / orchestration AWS Lambda, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Step Functions Storage & data lake Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS (PostgreSQL) APIs & compute Amazon API Gateway, Amazon ECS Fargate Identity & access Amazon Cognito, AWS IAM Monitoring Amazon CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray
How The Data Flows
Step
Capture
Snap Spectacles and mobile devices send inspection imagery to Amazon S3; ECM telemetry streams through AWS IoT Core and Kinesis.
Understand
YOLOv8 and Rekognition analyse imagery for faults; Textract extracts structured data from documents; embeddings are written to OpenSearch.
Reason
The Bedrock-hosted Claude assistant retrieves the right documents and ECM records to answer questions and summarise vehicle condition.
Act
The scheduler converts findings into work orders and assignments; anomalies are routed to the fraud-detection model for review.
Insurance Fraud Detection

Because every inspection is captured through smart glasses with a time stamp, geotag, and vehicle ID, the platform produces a tamper-evident evidence trail for each truck. This same data pipeline directly strengthens insurance operations:
Pre/post-incident evidence
Adjusters can retrieve the vehicle’s documented condition immediately before and after an incident, making inflated or fabricated damage claims easy to challenge.
Anomaly scoring
Amazon Fraud Detector and a custom SageMaker model score each claim against historical patterns, ECM data, and inspection history, flagging inconsistencies for human review.
Faster, defensible payouts
Legitimate claims are substantiated instantly with cited evidence, while suspicious ones are surfaced before payment.
Project Highlights
Results
The unifying effect of a single channel - detection, documents, scheduling, and ECM data in one place - translated directly into recovered spend.
15% Reduction
Fleet cost leakage
85% Reduction
Preventable breakdowns / unplanned downtime
42% Faster
Inspection time per vehicle
15% Of Claims
Insurance claims substantiated with evidence
Why It Worked
One channel eliminated the leaks
Cost leakage thrived in the gaps between disconnected tools; unifying them closed those gaps.
Condition-based, not calendar-based
Servicing trucks on real ECM and vision data removed both wasted maintenance and surprise breakdowns.
Evidence by default
Hands-free, time-stamped capture made audits and insurance disputes fast and winnable.
Conclusion

By replacing four disconnected tools with a single AWS-based intelligence platform – RAG, computer vision, smart-glasses capture, an intelligent scheduler, and live ECM data – the operator turned scattered data into recovered budget and defensible evidence. The result: roughly 15% less cost leakage across 1,500 trucks, faster maintenance decisions, and a fraud-resistant insurance process.

blocks.text: MindShift: An AI-Powered Personal Growth & Wellbeing App
Designing and building a 24/7 AI coaching, journaling, and mindfulness platform for Avenue Group Australia — from concept to the App Store and Google Play.
Book a Discovery Call
Executive Summary

Avenue Group Australia set out to build MindShift — a mental-wellbeing and personal-growth app positioned as “a mini therapist in your pocket,” available 24/7. The vision was ambitious: bring real-time AI coaching, guided meditations, journaling, affirmations, focus tools, and a supportive community together in a single, calming, multipurpose app that works for auditory, visual, and text-based learners alike.

We partnered with Avenue Group to take MindShift from concept to launch — owning product design, user experience, cross-platform mobile development, and AI integration. The result is a polished app now live on the App Store and Google Play, spanning more than eight growth tools, a 24/7 AI personal coach, wearable integration, and a gamified MindCoins system that lets users unlock premium features without a subscription.
This case study covers what we built, the product and engineering approach behind it, and the design decisions that make MindShift both accessible and genuinely engaging.
The Client

Avenue Group Australia, based in Perth, WA, wanted to help people navigate the stress, anxiety, and overthinking of modern life. MindShift was born partly from lived experience with ADHD, which shaped a core commitment: design an app that helps neurodiverse minds find focus and stillness, not one that overwhelms them with noise. The brief called for far more than a meditation library. Avenue Group envisioned an all-in-one companion that could coach, track, motivate, and connect — while remaining free to start, with a fair path to premium value.
The Challenge
Building a multipurpose wellbeing app that stays simple is hard. The project had to reconcile several competing demands:
Breadth without clutter
Combine 8+ distinct tools — journaling, affirmations, meditation, focus mode, AI coaching, faith content, community — in one app that still feels calm and uncluttered.
A genuinely useful AI coach
Deliver conversational coaching that understands context and adapts to each user's real behaviour, mood, and streaks — not generic scripted replies.
Accessibility for different minds
Serve auditory, visual, and text-based learners, with a purpose-built experience for the ADHD community.
Engagement that lasts
Most people abandon new habits within three months; the app needed mechanics that keep users returning without feeling pushy.
A fair monetisation model
Offer real free value while giving users a no-credit-card way to sample premium — the MindCoins concept.
Cross-platform parity
Ship a consistent, high-quality experience on iOS, Android, and wearables.
Our Solution: What We Built
We designed and developed MindShift as a single, cohesive app with a deep feature set. Highlights include:
AI Personal Coach 24/7 conversational coach that supports goal-setting, habit-building, and recovery — adapting to the user's actual behaviour, streaks, and skipped actions.
Journaling Guided journaling to organise thoughts, build problem-solving habits, and improve emotional clarity.
Affirmation Studio Personalised affirmations that retrain focus toward the positive.
Focus Mode & MindShift 30 Distraction-free focus sessions, including a 30-minute deep-focus mode that ends with guided prompts (Insight & Inspiration, Money & Motivation).
Weekly Challenges Habit challenges designed to counter the high early drop-off rate of new routines.
Progress Tracker Weekly/monthly tracking of journals, moods, streaks, challenges, and MindCoin history.
Coaching Corner Audio sessions on resilience, EQ, leadership, sales confidence, and goal-setting — with offline bookmarking.
Faith Module Daily devotionals and a supportive faith community for spiritual reflection.
ADHD Community An opt-in social feed with posts, likes, comments, following, and private chat for neurodiverse users.
Wearable Integration Mood logs, focus-timer updates, and gentle check-ins delivered to the user's watch.
MindCoins Earn coins through app usage and redeem them for premium access — no subscription required.
Product & Engineering Approach

Rather than committing to a single technology at every layer, we selected an architecture built for a smooth cross-platform experience, responsive AI interactions, and reliable offline use. At a high level:
Cross-platform mobile foundation.
A shared codebase approach delivered consistent iOS and Android experiences while allowing platform-native polish where it mattered.
Conversational AI coaching layer.
The AI coach interprets chat and journaling context to respond meaningfully and reflect the user's mood and momentum, with guardrails appropriate to a wellbeing product.
Behaviour-aware personalisation.
Streaks, skipped actions, and recovery patterns feed back into coaching and challenges so guidance aligns with real behaviour rather than idealized plans.
Offline-first content.
Coaching audio and key tools work offline via bookmarking, so support is available regardless of connectivity.
Wearable sync.
Lightweight, glanceable interactions extend mood logging and focus timers to the wrist.
Secure, scalable backend.
Cloud services handle accounts, content delivery, the community feed, and coin balances, designed to scale as the user base grows.
Design Principles
Every design decision served one goal: give a busy, overloaded mind permission to breathe.
Calm by default
A quiet visual language and uncluttered flows that reduce cognitive load rather than add to it.
Built for every learner
Audio, visual, and text formats for the same content so users engage in the way that suits them.
ADHD-first thinking
Focus tools, gentle nudges, and an opt-in community shaped around neurodiverse needs.
Low-friction onboarding
Start free, no credit card — value first, commitment later
Conclusion

For Avenue Group Australia, we turned an ambitious vision — a 24/7 AI wellbeing companion built with genuine empathy for neurodiverse users — into a shipped, cross-platform product spanning coaching, journaling, focus, faith, community, and wearables, unified by a fair MindCoins model. MindShift shows how we take a consumer AI concept from first sketch to live app stores: thoughtful UX, dependable engineering, and AI that meets people where they actually are.

blocks.text: Rele.one: Building a National Real-Estate Platform with Vibe Coding
How we designed and shipped a full AI-powered property marketplace for all of Australia — fast — using an AI-assisted “vibe coding” workflow.
Book a Discovery Call
Executive Summary

Rele set out to launch a modern, national real-estate marketplace for Australia — a single place to buy, rent, and invest across all eight states and territories, with verified agents, AI-powered search, and live market data. Competing in a market dominated by long-entrenched incumbents meant Rele needed to reach a polished, feature-complete product quickly, without a multi-year build.

We delivered exactly that using a vibe coding approach — an AI-assisted development workflow that pairs experienced engineers with AI tools (Claude Code and AI app builders such as Lovable, v0, and Bolt) to design, generate, and refine production code at a dramatically faster pace. The result is rele.one: a fast, server-rendered Next.js platform with AI property search, agent profiles, market insights, and a full suite of buyer tools — shipped in a fraction of the time a traditional build would take.
This case study explains what we built, how vibe coding accelerated it, and why the approach delivers speed without sacrificing quality.
The Client & Vision

Rele's vision was to become Australia's most trusted property platform — combining extensive, verified listings with a genuinely modern search experience and transparent market data. The brief was ambitious: cover the entire country, serve buyers, renters, investors, and agents alike, and feel faster and cleaner than the established players from day one. For a new entrant, time-to-market is everything. Rele needed to move from concept to a credible, comprehensive product before that window closed.
The Challenge
Building a national real-estate marketplace is a large undertaking. The project had to deliver a lot, quickly, and to a high standard:
Breadth of scope
Listings for sale, rent, and sold; new developments; agent directories; news, blogs, and guides; plus financial calculators — a genuine platform, not a landing page.
A modern search experience
Both a natural-language AI search (“3 bed Sydney”, “QLD invest”) and traditional filters, across every state and territory.
Trust and verification
Background-checked, licensed agents and verified listings, so users can transact with confidence.
Performance and SEO
A fast, server-rendered experience that ranks well and loads instantly — essential in a search-driven category.
Speed to market
All of the above, delivered fast enough to compete with incumbents that have had years and large teams.
Our Approach: Vibe Coding

“Vibe coding” is an AI-assisted way of building software: instead of hand-writing every line, engineers describe intent in natural language, generate working code and UI with AI tools, then review, refine, and harden it. Used well, it compresses the slowest parts of development — scaffolding, boilerplate, and first-draft UI — from weeks into hours, while engineers stay firmly in control of architecture, quality, and security.
AI-generated UI, human-refined
We used AI app builders (Lovable, v0, Bolt) to rapidly produce the page layouts, components, and responsive design, then refined them by hand for polish and brand consistency.
Claude Code as the engineering copilot
We used Claude Code to generate and iterate on application logic, API integrations, search behaviour, and data models — reviewing every change rather than accepting it blindly.
Tight iteration loops
Rapid prompt-generate-review cycles let us prototype features, get them in front of the client, and adjust in the same day.
Engineering discipline retained
AI accelerated the work; experienced engineers still owned architecture, code review, performance, accessibility, and security — so speed never came at the cost of a fragile product.
What We Built
Rele.one launched as a comprehensive, production-grade marketplace. Core capabilities include:
AI Property Search Natural-language search (e.g. “3 bed Sydney”, “Apt Melbourne”, “QLD invest”) alongside classic manual filters.
Buy · Rent · Sold Unified listings across sale, rental, and sold properties, filterable by state and suburb.
Nationwide coverage Browse by all 8 states and territories — NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, NT, ACT.
Verified agents Background-checked, locally rated licensed agents and agent profiles for trusted transactions.
Live market data Real-time price trends, auction clearance rates, and suburb reports.
Buyer tools Affordability calculator, borrowing-power calculator, and a dedicated insights/REA calculator.
New developments A dedicated section for off-the-plan and new-build opportunities.
Insights & content Property news, RBA rate updates, blogs, and suburb-by-suburb guides for SEO and engagement.
For Agents An agent onboarding and listing pathway to grow supply on the platform.
Technology & Why It's Better
The platform is built on a modern, SEO-friendly web stack, delivered through an AI-accelerated workflow.

Area Choice & rationale Framework Next.js / React — server-side rendering for fast loads and strong SEO, essential in a search-driven property market. AI-assisted build Claude Code + AI app builders (Lovable / v0 / Bolt) — compress scaffolding and UI work, enabling rapid, iterative delivery. AI search Natural-language query understanding layered over structured listing filters, for a search experience that feels effortless. Content & insights A content layer (news, guides, calculators) that drives organic search traffic and repeat visits. Verification layer Agent background-checks and listing verification to build trust from day one.
Why vibe coding was the right call
Speed to market
AI-assisted generation let us reach a feature-complete, national platform far faster than a traditional hand-built approach — the single biggest advantage for a new entrant.
Rapid iteration
Prompt-driven changes meant the client saw and shaped features in real time, not after long dev cycles.
Cost efficiency
Less time on boilerplate meant more budget spent on the things that differentiate — search quality, data, and polish.
Quality preserved
Human engineering oversight on architecture, performance, and security ensured the AI-accelerated build is production-grade, not a throwaway prototype.
Conclusion

For Rele, we turned an ambitious vision — a trusted, national, AI-powered property marketplace — into a live, comprehensive product, and we did it fast by embracing vibe coding. AI-assisted development handled the heavy lifting of UI and scaffolding, while our engineers steered architecture, quality, and performance. The outcome is rele.one: a modern Next.js platform spanning every Australian state, with AI search, verified agents, live market data, and buyer tools — proof that AI-accelerated delivery can ship serious products without cutting corners.
